decisions.reason: It is very close to the firm's established dairy range and the award signal gives management confidence that existing know-how can be used to improve and commercialise it further.
As a homepage-highlighted flagship cheese that builds directly on the firm's core cheese competence, it fits strongly with existing knowledge and is unlikely to be withdrawn quickly.
This semi-hard cheese is close to the established offer, so even without visible strong R&D capability the firm can understand customer feedback and refine it within its core business.
A spicy cheese line with several variants stays within the firm's familiar cheese domain, which supports learning and adjustment and therefore favors retention.
The mild creamy soft cheese extends the existing cheese range in a related way, making it a manageable incremental innovation that the firm is likely to continue.
Although washed-rind soft cheese may be somewhat more niche, it still relies on the firm's established cheese-making knowledge, so management would more likely keep than drop it.
